articles.title: What Is Agent Experience (Ax)?
articles.summary: Agent Experience is the experience AI agents have when discovering, choosing, and using your technology. Practicing AX means systematically improving that experience. Comparing FLOP/s alone would therefore underestimate GB300’s inference capacity relative to H100 by a factor of ten.
